title: Personal Agent Skill Eval Manifest
description: An optional Personal Agent quality layer for a Skill Pack. This file is not required by Anthropic Skills, but lets this project run local skill regression evals.

skill_name.description: Name of the Skill Pack this manifest evaluates. It should match SKILL.md frontmatter name.

evals.description: Eval cases that are each run as a normal Personal Agent Task Run.

prompt.description: User-like prompt used to exercise the Skill Pack.

expected_output.description: Expected evidence for the default contains grader, or human-readable rubric for other graders.

files.description: Optional workspace-relative fixture files needed by this eval case.

grader.description: Optional grader. Missing grader defaults to contains(expected_output).

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression pattern matched against the final Task Report with i and u flags.

rubric.description: Rubric used by the configured Model Provider to judge the final Task Report semantically.

judge_runs.description: Optional number of repeated judge calls. Defaults to 1.

pass_threshold.description: Optional number of pass verdicts required across judge_runs. Defaults to judge_runs.

tool.description: Local Tool name that must appear in the Task Run event trace.

input_contains.description: Optional substring that must appear in the serialized input of a matching Local Tool call.

input_matches.description: Optional partial JSON object that must match the input of a matching Local Tool call.

input_schema.description: Optional compact JSON Schema-style matcher for the input of a matching Local Tool call.

output_contains.description: Optional substring that must appear in the serialized output of a matching Local Tool result.

output_matches.description: Optional partial JSON object that must match the output of a matching Local Tool result.

output_type.description: Optional JSON-style top-level type required for the output of a matching Local Tool result.

output_schema.description: Optional compact JSON Schema-style matcher for the output of a matching Local Tool result.

type.description: Supported JSON-style value type, or a non-empty list of accepted value types.

required.description: Object properties that must be present when validating an object value.

items.description: Nested schema used for every array item.

const.description: Literal JSON value that must match exactly.

enum.description: Literal JSON values where at least one must match.

anyOf.description: Alternative schema branches where at least one must match.

additionalProperties.description: Use false to reject object keys not declared in properties.
